name: Unsaved Husbands
overview: Scripture instructs wives to submit to their husbands as to the Lord, even when husbands are unsaved, emphasizing respectful and obedient behavior to uphold the honor of God's Word. At the same time, husbands are called to love their wives deeply, as loving their own bodies, which sets a standard of sacrificial care and unity. Wisdom in speech is crucial, as gentle answers can defuse anger, while harsh words provoke strife, highlighting the power of the tongue in maintaining peace within the household. Older women are also encouraged to teach good behavior, avoiding false accusations and strife, fostering an environment of holiness and discretion.
